exercises.question: Which sentence expresses probability? [¿Cuál expresa probabilidad?]
options: Probablemente habrá más cambios. [There will probably be more changes.]
Habrá más cambios. [There will be more changes.]
Hubo más cambios. [There were more changes.]

exercises.sentence: ___ habrá nuevas profesiones. (probably) [There will probably be new professions.]
exercises.english: There will probably be new professions.
It is possible that society will be different.

exercises.question: Which word means «to predict»? [¿Qué palabra significa «predecir»?]
options: predecir [to predict]
transformar [to transform]
prepararse [to prepare]
